## Checklist

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`pytest -q`)
- [ ] Frontend tests + build pass (`vitest run` && `npm run build`)
- [ ] No secrets / cookies / tokens / personal data / host paths added
- [ ] `.gitignore` / `.dockerignore` not weakened
- [ ] Does not flip the release-check to PASS or add an active vulnerability exception
- [ ] No unattended download / real-YouTube-fetch code path or test
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (if user-facing)
